column3: Preserves “integrity of your heart” rather than “a clear conscience”.
Preserves speaking “all these words in their ears” rather than describing all that happened.
Preserves “What did you see?” rather than “What prompted you?”.
Preserves the image “a covering of eyes” rather than replacing it with “vindication”.
Preserves “they bore children” rather than the restored ability “could again bear children”.
